name: @ducat-unit/wallet-snap
description: Ducat Bitcoin account and signing Snap for MetaMask.

scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm test && npm run build && npm run manifest
scripts.build:harness-dev: DUCAT_SNAP_ARTIFACT_POLICY=development DUCAT_SNAP_DEV_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8075,http://frontend:3000,http://ducat-admin:8075 DUCAT_SNAP_DEV_UNPROMPTED=false DUCAT_SNAP_DEBUG=false node scripts/prepare-dev-build.mjs && DUCAT_SNAP_ARTIFACT_POLICY=development DUCAT_SNAP_DEV_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8075,http://frontend:3000,http://ducat-admin:8075 DUCAT_SNAP_DEV_UNPROMPTED=false DUCAT_SNAP_DEBUG=false mm-snap build --config snap.config.dev.ts && DUCAT_SNAP_ARTIFACT_POLICY=development DUCAT_SNAP_DEV_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8075,http://frontend:3000,http://ducat-admin:8075 node scripts/apply-dev-origins.mjs .snap/dev/snap.manifest.json && mm-snap manifest --config snap.config.dev.ts --fix
scripts.verify:bitvm3: npm run harness:bitvm3-reclaim && npm run harness:bitvm3-reclaim-reject
scripts.verify:harness: npm run harness:accounts && npm run build:harness-dev && npm run harness:smoke-signing && npm run verify:bitvm3
